body.resource_hint: Use dnu=d^3p/(2E_p) and normalized positive ghost-even packets. After the common active contraction, define W_T(k,p)=Re[5 sum_R beta_A,T+6 sum_N beta_A,T], with diagonal value W_kappa(T) at the certified tagged fixture. The exact relative tree cross is (2 sqrt(2) lambda^2/3) Re[conj(<g,f>) <g,W_T f>]. On compact supports with D_A>=d0, |W_T|<=54T/d0. For N equal cells of dnu-measure h and a uniform normalized packet, the matrix element is (h/N) sum_ij W_ij; for a constant kernel this is Nh W=mu W. N=1 and h=1/(2EV) recovers W/N_s, while fixed mu=Nh survives refinement. Continuity and W_kappa(T)>0 give a nonzero positive compact packet for every fixed T>0.
